description: Source code for the 'git reset' builtin command, implementing various reset operations in Git, including index and working tree modifications, with command-line parsing and repository state management.

methods.name: reset_index
methods.description: Resets the index and working tree to a specific tree object, handling different reset types such as mixed, hard, keep, and merge.

methods.name: print_new_head_line
methods.description: Prints the new HEAD position after a reset.

methods.name: update_index_from_diff
methods.description: Updates the index entries based on a diff queue, used during reset operations.

methods.name: read_from_tree
methods.description: Reads a tree object into the index, optionally marking files for addition.

methods.name: set_reflog_message
methods.description: Constructs a reflog message for HEAD or other ref updates.

methods.name: die_if_unmerged_cache
methods.description: Checks if the index is in a merge state and aborts if so, preventing resets during merges.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the reset command, determining revision and pathspecs.

methods.name: reset_refs
methods.description: Updates the refs for HEAD and ORIG_HEAD after a reset.

methods.name: git_reset_config
methods.description: Handles configuration options related to reset command.

methods.name: cmd_reset
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git reset' command, handling argument parsing, repository state updates, and invoking reset operations.
